title: QA AI Assistant for TAC 459
summary: A RAG assistant that answers TAC 459 course questions from lecture materials with cited answers.
description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based assistant designed for answering course-related queries using lecture materials. It enhances learning through real-time, course-specific answers.
built: It uses a vector database and LLMs to retrieve relevant course materials, allowing students to receive precise, cited answers with minimal instructor intervention.
